name: SSHI_FBR_Clamp
rationale: The reference FBR fails on S2 and S4 due to insufficient power and on S3 due to overvoltage and ripple. I am implementing a Parallel SSHI (Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor) circuit to invert the piezoelectric capacitance voltage at the peaks, significantly increasing the extracted power. To protect the load in S3, a Zener diode (DZ33) is added to clamp the output voltage at 3.3V. A large output capacitor is used to minimize ripple and stabilize the voltage for S5.
